Save every drop

Small habits add up over a long dry summer. Take shorter showers at home and keep the bowl from the sink for the tomatoes. Turn off the tap while you brush your teeth, mulch your beds with straw so the soil stays damp for longer, and use a can at the roots of each plant rather than a spray over the leaves. Dig compost into the beds in spring so they hold what the rain gives them, and plant thirsty crops close together so they shade the ground.
